source.primary_witnesses: **NO HEBREW DSS WITNESS for Jub 3** (no 4Q216, no 4Q218, no other Hebrew Jubilees fragment preserves this chapter). Greek not preserved for this chapter. Ge'ez (Charles 1902 PD + VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511 critical edition) is the SOLE WITNESS.
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention (ḫ ḫ̣ ʾ ʿ ä for ä-vowel; q ṗ ṣ̌).

source.citation: VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia; Charles 1902; Kugel 2012 A Walk through Jubilees.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 3 — EDEN: Adam-naming-animals, creation of Eve, the snake, the fall, the curse, the burials. **WITNESS-ATTESTATION: GE'EZ-ONLY for the entire chapter.** Jubilees 3 contains the key TWO-STAGE-CREATION (Adam first, Eve second after 7 days — vv 1-8) and the FOUNDING OF FEMALE-PURITY-RULES (vv 8-14) and the EDEN-AS-TEMPLE typology (vv 12, 27 — Eden as holy-of-holies). Cross-corpus density on Eden-as-temple is significant: cf. Gen 2-3 source, cf. 1 En 24-25 (Mountain of God), cf. 4QInstruction, cf. Ezek 28 (Eden-as-mountain-temple).

verses.text_geez: ወበዕለት፡ ሳድስት፡ ሰዱስ፡ ሳምንት፡ ካልእት፡ አምጻእነ፡ በቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ አዳም፡ ኵሎ፡ አራዊተ፡ ወኵሎ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወኵሎ፡ አዕዋፈ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ውስተ፡ ማይ፡ በበ፡ ዘመዱ፡ ወበበ፡ ምስሎሙ፡ አራዊተ፡ በዕለት፡ ቀዳሚት፡ ወእንስሳ፡ በዕለት፡ ካልእት፡ ወአዕዋፈ፡ በዕለት፡ ሣልስት፡ ወእለ፡ ይትሐወሱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ በዕለት፡ ራብዕት፡ ወእለ፡ ይትሐወሱ፡ ውስተ፡ ማይ፡ በዕለት፡ ሐምስት፡ ወሰመዮሙ፡ አዳም፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በበ፡ ስማቲሆሙ፡ ወዘሰመዮሙ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ኮነ፡ ስሞሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-ʿəlat sādəstə sədus sāmənt kāləʾt ʾamṣaʾəna ba-qāla ʾəgziʾabəḥēr ḫaba ʾAdām kwəlo ʾarāwita wa-kwəlo ʾənəssā wa-kwəlo ʾaʿwāfa wa-kwəlo za-yətḥawwas lāʿla mədr wa-kwəlo za-yətḥawwas wəsta māy baba zamadu wa-baba məslomu ʾarāwita ba-ʿəlat qadāmit wa-ʾənəssā ba-ʿəlat kāləʾt wa-ʾaʿwāfa ba-ʿəlat śāləstə wa-ʾəlla yətḥawwasu lāʿla mədr ba-ʿəlat rābəʿt wa-ʾəlla yətḥawwasu wəsta māy ba-ʿəlat ḥaməst wa-samayomu ʾAdām kwəlomu baba səmātihomu wa-zasamayomu ʾəmənnehu kona səmomu
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 3:1; VanderKam 1989) — Hebrew NOT preserved; Greek NOT preserved
verses.notes: **Day 6 of the 2nd week — Adam names all the animals over a five-day naming-sequence.** **JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE STRUCTURE**: Adam names beasts on day 1 of week 2, livestock on day 2, birds on day 3, creeping things on day 4, sea-creatures on day 5 — a five-day naming-week ordered by creation-day-sequence. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 2:19-20 (Adam names the animals); cf. b. Pesaḥim 54a (Adam names by language); cf. Pirqe Avot 5:6 (Adam's tongs). The Jubilees naming-week embeds animal-classification into the calendrical week-of-weeks structure of the book.

verses.text_geez: ወበአምስቱ፡ ዕለት፡ እሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ መጽኡ፡ ኀበ፡ አዳም፡ በውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ከመ፡ ይሰምዮሙ፡ ወኮኑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በበ፡ ዘመዱ፡ ወአሐደ፡ አሐደ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ወኮነ፡ አዳም፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘረከበ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-ʾaməstu ʿəlat ʾəllu kwəlomu maṣʾu ḫaba ʾAdām ba-wəsta ganata ʾEdom kama yəsammomu wa-konu kwəlomu baba zamadu wa-ʾaḥada ʾaḥada məsla bəʾəsitu məslēhu wa-kona ʾAdām bāḥtitu wa-ʾalbo zarakaba la-rəʾəsu məslēhu bəʾəsita
verses.notes: **Adam alone — every animal has a mate except Adam.** Setup for Eve's creation. Rewrite of Gen 2:20b ('but for Adam there was not found a help meet for him').

verses.text_geez: ወይቤለነ፡ እግዚእ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ሠናየ፡ ይኩን፡ ሰብእ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ንግበር፡ ሎቱ፡ ረዳኤ፡ ዘይትከሐሎ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēlana ʾəgziʾ ʾi-kona śannāya yəkun sabʾ bāḥtitu nəgbar lottu radāʾē za-yətkaḥalo
verses.notes: **'It is not good for man to be alone — let us make him a helper fit for him.'** Direct citation of Gen 2:18 (the only verse in Gen 1-2 with a 'not good' verdict — the lack of partner).

verses.text_geez: ወአንበሮ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላክነ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ሰዊመ፡ ወንዋመ፡ ወሰከበ፡ ወአንቅሐ፡ እምነ፡ ንዋሙ፡ በሰዱስ፡ ዕለት፡ በወርኅ፡ ካልእ፡ ወቦአ፡ ኀቤሁ፡ ወአርአዮ፡ ወወፅአት፡ ብእሲት፡ ካልአዊት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾanbaro ʾəgziʾ ʾamlākəna lāʿlēhu sawima wa-nəwāma wa-sakaba wa-ʾanqəḥa ʾəm-nəwāmu ba-sadus ʿəlat ba-warḫ kāləʾ wa-boʾa ḫabēhu wa-ʾarʾayo wa-waḍʾat bəʾəsit kāləʾāwit
verses.notes: **God puts Adam to sleep on day 6 of the second month, and Eve is brought forth.** Rewrite of Gen 2:21-22. Note: Jubilees DATES Eve's creation precisely — day 6 of month 2, year 1. **Calendrical precision is the Jubilees signature; every event is dated within the 49-year jubilee grid.**

verses.text_geez: ወአውፅአ፡ ሎቱ፡ እምነ፡ ገበዋቲሁ፡ ዐጽመ፡ አሐደ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ብእሲት፡ እምዐጽሙ፡ ወመንበረ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ወመንበረ፡ አምሳለ፡ አዳም፡ ወወሀበ፡ ሎቱ፡ መጻተ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ፍጽፅረ፡ ለርእሱ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾawḍəʾa lottu ʾəm-nə gabawātihu ʿaṣma ʾaḥada wa-wəʾtu bəʾəsit ʾəm-ʿaṣmu wa-manbara śəgāhu wa-manbara ʾamsāla ʾAdām wa-wahaba lottu maṣṣata śəgāhu fəṣəṣəra la-rəʾəsu
verses.notes: **Rib-extraction.** Rewrite of Gen 2:21-22.

verses.text_geez: ወአንቅሐ፡ አዳም፡ እምነ፡ ንዋሙ፡ ወአንሥአ፡ ወርእየ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ቅሩበ፡ ወይቤ፡ ነየ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዐጽም፡ እምነ፡ ዐጽምየ፡ ወይእቲ፡ ሥጋ፡ እምነ፡ ሥጋየ፡ እንተ፡ ትሰመይ፡ ብእሲት፡ እስመ፡ እምነ፡ ምታ፡ ተወስደት፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾanqəḥa ʾAdām ʾəm-nə nəwāmu wa-ʾansəʾa wa-rəʾəya bəʾəsita məslēhu qərruba wa-yəbē naya yəʾəti ʿaṣəm ʾəm-nə ʿaṣəməya wa-yəʾəti śəgā ʾəm-nə śəgāya ʾənta təssammay bəʾəsit ʾəsma ʾəm-nə mətā tawəsdat
verses.notes: **Adam's recognition song.** 'This is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh' — direct citation of Gen 2:23. The Hebrew etymology of אשה ishah ← איש ish is present in the Ge'ez bəʾəsit ← mət (her-husband) etymology.

verses.text_geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይኀድግ፡ ብእሲ፡ አባሁ፡ ወእሞ፡ ወይትሌጠ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ወይከውኑ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ሥጋ፡ አሐደ፡
verses.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu yəḫadəg bəʾəsi ʾabbāhu wa-ʾəmmo wa-yətlēṭa məsla bəʾəsitu wa-yəkawwənu kwəlomu śəgā ʾaḥada
verses.notes: **'Therefore a man leaves father and mother and clings to his wife.'** Direct citation of Gen 2:24. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cited as foundational marriage-text in Matt 19:5, Mark 10:7-8, 1 Cor 6:16, Eph 5:31.

verses.text_geez: በሳምንት፡ ቀዳሚት፡ ተፈጥረ፡ አዳም፡ ወወገንዱ፡ መሳርየ፡ ወበሳምንት፡ ካልእ፡ አርአያ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለመትኒ፡ እስመ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ለትትፈለጥ፡ ብእሲት፡ እምነ፡ ምታ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ዕለታተ፡ በዘወልደት፡ ተባዕተ፡ ወወልደት፡ አንስተ፡ ሰማንየ፡ ወእንዘ፡ ኢትትፈለጥ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ እስከ፡ ይትፌጸም፡ ሎሙ፡ መዋዕል፡ እሉ፡ በከመ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ለትባዕት፡ ሠላሳ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ወለአንስት፡ ስሳ፡ ዕለታተ፡
verses.translit: ba-sāmənt qadāmit tafaṭra ʾAdām wa-waganədu masāriya wa-ba-sāmənt kāləʾ ʾarʾayā lottu la-matni ʾəsma la-zəntu taʾazaza la-tətfalaṭ bəʾəsit ʾəm-nə mətā sabʿa ʿəlatāta ba-zawaldat tabāʿta wa-waldat ʾanəsta samānya wa-ʾənza ʾi-tətfalaṭ bēta maqdas ʾəska yətfēṣṣam lomu mawāʿəl ʾəllu ba-kama taʾazaza la-tbāʿt śalāsā ʿəlatāta wa-la-ʾanəst səssā ʿəlatāta
verses.notes: **THE TWO-STAGE CREATION + PURITY-RULES ETIOLOGY.** **CRITICAL JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — Adam created week 1, Eve created week 2.** This is the etiology of Levitical postpartum-purity rules (Lev 12:1-5): a woman is unclean 7 days for a male birth and 14 days for a female birth, plus 33 days additional for male and 66 days additional for female (40 and 80 total). **Adam-male-created-week-1 → 40-day exclusion for male birth; Eve-female-created-week-2 → 80-day exclusion for female birth.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS**: this etiology grounds Levitical purity in the creation-week structure — a Jubilees-distinctive halakhic-etiology technique. cf. Lev 12:1-5; cf. 4QMMT (Halakhic Letter) section on postpartum purity.

verses.text_geez: ወእምድኅረ፡ አርብዓ፡ ዕለታት፡ ለአዳም፡ ጊዜ፡ ፈጸመ፡ አንሰ፡ አምጻእነ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ከመ፡ ይትገበር፡ ወይዕቅባ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ በሰማንያ፡ ዕለት፡ አምጻእናሃ፡ ወእምድኅረዝ፡ ቦአት፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫra ʾarbəʿā ʿəlatāt la-ʾAdām gizē faṣṣama ʾanəsa ʾamṣaʾəna kiyāhu wəsta ganata ʾEdom kama yətgabbar wa-yəʿqəbā wa-bəʾəsitu ba-samānya ʿəlat ʾamṣaʾənāhā wa-ʾəmdəḫrazə boʾat wəsta ganata ʾEdom
verses.notes: **Adam enters Eden after 40 days, Eve after 80 days — exactly the Levitical purity-periods.** Reinforces the previous verse's etiology.

verses.text_geez: ወበእንተዝ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ በበ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ለዘወለደት፡ ለእንተ፡ ወለደት፡ ተባዕተ፡ ለትንበር፡ በርኵሰ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ወከመ፡ ሠላሳ፡ ዕለታት፡ ወካዕበ፡ ሠላሳ፡ ዕለታት፡ ለትንበር፡ በደመ፡ ንጽሐ፡ ወአልባቲ፡ ትግባእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሥሙረ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ወውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ኢትባእ፡ እስከ፡ ይትፌጸሙ፡ ዝንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ እለ፡ ለተባዕት፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-ʾəntazə taʾazaza lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy baba ʿəlatāta la-zawaladat la-ʾənta waladat tabāʿta la-tnabbar ba-rəkwsa sabʿa ʿəlatāta wa-kama śalāsā ʿəlatāt wa-kāʿba śalāsā ʿəlatāt la-tnabbar ba-dama nəṣḥa wa-ʾalbāti təgbāʾ kwəlo śmura qəddusa wa-wəsta bēta maqdas ʾi-təbāʾ ʾəska yətfēṣṣamu zəntu mawāʿəl ʾəllu la-tabāʿt
verses.notes: **'For this reason it was commanded on THE HEAVENLY TABLETS concerning the woman who has given birth.'** **MAJOR — HEAVENLY TABLETS CITATION**: this is the FIRST EXPLICIT 'heavenly tablets' reference in Jubilees. **Bidirectional with v2.67.0 glossary entry `heavenly-tablets-1-enoch-81-jubilees-daniel-revelation-cross-corpus`.** Levitical postpartum law inscribed pre-Levitically on the heavenly tablets — Lev 12 is the codification of an eternal heavenly law. **The temple-exclusion language ('and she shall not enter the sanctuary')** confirms the EDEN-AS-TEMPLE typology developed throughout the chapter.

verses.text_geez: ወዘወለደት፡ አንስተ፡ ለትንበር፡ በርኵሰ፡ ሰማንየ፡ ዕለታተ፡ ሰሙናት፡ ክልኤ፡ ወወልደ፡ አምሳለ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ ሰዳሳ፡ ወሰዱስ፡ ዕለታት፡ በደመ፡ ንጽሐ፡ ወይከውን፡ ሰማንየ፡ ዕለታት፡ ኵሉ፡ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡
verses.translit: wa-zawaladat ʾanəsta la-tnabbar ba-rəkwsa samānya ʿəlatāta samunāt kələʾē wa-walda ʾamsāla qadāmi sadāsā wa-sadus ʿəlatāt ba-dama nəṣḥa wa-yəkawwən samānya ʿəlatāt kwəlu məsla kāləʾu
verses.notes: **Female birth: 14 + 66 = 80 days of impurity.** Codifies Lev 12:5 within the Jubilees Eden-etiology.

verses.text_geez: ወእምድኅረ፡ ፈጸመት፡ ዘንተ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ንጽሐ፡ አምጻእናሃ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ እስመ፡ ቅድስት፡ ይእቲ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘውስተቴሁ፡ ይትከሰት፡ ቅዱስ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫra faṣṣamat zanta mawāʿəla nəṣḥa ʾamṣaʾənāhā wəsta ganata ʾEdom ʾəsma qəddəst yəʾəti ʾəm-nə kwəlu mədr wa-kwəlu ʿəḍ za-wəstatēhu yətkaśśat qəddusa
verses.notes: **EDEN AS HOLIEST PLACE ON EARTH.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — EDEN-AS-TEMPLE/HOLY-OF-HOLIES TYPOLOGY**: 'the Garden of Eden — for it is more holy than all the earth, and every tree planted in it is holy.' This is the foundational Jubilees Eden-as-temple/holy-of-holies typology. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 24-25 (the mountain of God with the Tree of Life); cf. Ezek 28:13-14 (Eden as 'mountain of God, holy mountain'); cf. Ezek 47 (river from temple = Gen 2 river from Eden); cf. Heb 9-10 (holy of holies); cf. Rev 22:1-5 (eschatological-Eden as throne-room). The Jubilees position is foundational to the entire Second Temple Eden-as-temple tradition.

verses.text_geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ሥርዐት፡ ለዘወለደት፡ ለትባዕት፡ ወለአንስት፡ በበ፡ መዋዕሊሆሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትጋነኒ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ምድር፡ እንተ፡ ቅድስት፡ ለእግዚእ፡
verses.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu taʾazaza śərʿat la-zawaladat la-tabāʿt wa-la-ʾanəst baba mawāʿəlihomu ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾat kama ʾi-yətgāneni bēta maqdas zawəsta mədr ʾənta qəddəst la-ʾəgziʾ
verses.notes: **Purity-rules tied explicitly to TEMPLE-NON-DEFILEMENT.** Confirms again the Eden-as-temple typology.

verses.text_geez: ወካዕበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘያረኵስ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ መስተዋቅሕ፡ ለሞት፡ በከመ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ ሥርዐት፡
verses.translit: wa-kāʿba kwəlu zayāraqəs bēta maqdas mastawāqəḥ la-mot ba-kama ṣəḥuf wəsta śərʿat
verses.notes: **Defiling the temple = death-liable.** cf. Lev 15:31, Num 19:13, 20.

verses.text_geez: ወይነብር፡ አዳም፡ በውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ሰብዐ፡ ዓመተ፡ ለሰቢረ፡ ምድር፡ ወዕቀብታ፡ ወወሀብናሁ፡ ግብረ፡ ወመሀርናሁ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ግቢሮተ፡
verses.translit: wa-yənabbər ʾAdām ba-wəsta ganata ʾEdom sabʿa ʿāmata la-sabira mədr wa-ʿəqabtā wa-wahabnāhu gəbra wa-maharnāhu kwəlo gəbra zayəkawwən gəbirota
verses.notes: **SEVEN YEARS IN EDEN — Adam lives in Eden seven years tilling/keeping.** Jubilees-distinctive: a SEVEN-YEAR pre-fall period in Eden, structured by the jubilee-week-of-years scheme. This contrasts with rabbinic traditions where Adam falls on day 6 itself (b. Sanh. 38b). The 7-year pre-fall period is one of the most distinctive Jubilees-features.

verses.text_geez: ወይትገበር፡ ግብረ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ ትከይዶ፡ ወይከውና፡ ለትሕነጹ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ በውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡
verses.translit: wa-yətgabbar gəbra wa-bəʾəsitu təkayyədo wa-yəkawwənā la-tḥənaḍḍu məslēhu ba-wəsta ganata ʾEdom
verses.notes: **Eve assists Adam in tilling/keeping Eden.** The verse emphasizes joint labor; Eve is not subordinate at this pre-fall stage.

verses.text_geez: ወበፍጻሜ፡ ሰብዐቱ፡ ዓመት፡ እለ፡ ፈጸመ፡ በህየ፡ ሰብዐቱ፡ ዓመት፡ ፍጹመ፡ ወበካልእ፡ ወርኅ፡ በዐሡሩ፡ ወሰቡዑ፡ ዕለት፡ ለወርኅ፡ መጽአ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ወቀርበ፡ ኀበ፡ ብእሲት፡ ወይቤላ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ለብእሲት፡ በእንተ፡ ፍሬ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ገነት፡ ይቤለክን፡ ኢትብልዓ፡ እምኔሃ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-fəṣṣāmē sabʿatu ʿāmat ʾəlla faṣṣama ba-həya sabʿatu ʿāmat fəṣṣuma wa-ba-kāləʾ warḫ ba-ʿaśru wa-sabuʿu ʿəlat la-warḫ maṣʾa ʾarwē mədr wa-qarba ḫaba bəʾəsit wa-yəbēlā ʾarwē mədr la-bəʾəsit ba-ʾənta fəre ʿəḍ zawəsta ganat yəbēlakən ʾi-təbəlʿā ʾəmənnehā
verses.notes: **'AT THE END OF SEVEN YEARS — on the 17th day of the second month — the serpent came and approached the woman.'** **EXACT CALENDRICAL DATING OF THE FALL.** The serpent (ʾarwē mədr = 'beast of the earth' rather than Hebrew naḥash) approaches Eve at the very end of the seven-year period — i.e., immediately after the male-child purity-period (40 days x 7 = pattern matches?), suggesting Eve has 'completed' her sojourn. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 3:1; cf. Rev 12:9 (the serpent identified as Satan); cf. 2 Cor 11:3 (serpent deceiving Eve); cf. Wis 2:24 ('through the devil's envy death entered the world'). Notably, Jubilees does NOT name the serpent as Satan/Mastema — that explicit identification is Jubilees-distinctive-absent. Mastema is named in chs 10-11, 17, 18 but not in connection with the fall.

verses.text_geez: ወትቤሎ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ፍሬ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ገነት፡ ይቤለነ፡ እግዚእ፡ ብልዓ፡ ወእምነ፡ ፍሬ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ገነት፡ ይቤለነ፡ ኢትብልዓ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ወኢትግሥሥዎ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትሙታ፡
verses.translit: wa-təbēlo ʾəm-kwəlu fəre ʿəḍ zawəsta ganat yəbēlana ʾəgziʾ bəlʿa wa-ʾəm-nə fəre ʿəḍ zawəsta māʾkala ganat yəbēlana ʾi-təbəlʿā ʾəmənnehu wa-ʾi-təgśəśəwo kama ʾi-təmutā
verses.notes: **Eve's reply.** Direct citation/rewrite of Gen 3:2-3. Note the 'do not touch' addition (going beyond God's actual command in Gen 2:17, which forbade only eating) — the rabbinic tradition (Avot d'Rabbi Natan 1, Genesis Rabbah 19:3) flags this as Eve's faulty additional 'fence around the law' which the serpent exploited.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤላ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ለብእሲት፡ ኢመዊትከ፡ ትመውቱ፡ እስመ፡ የአምር፡ እግዚእ፡ ከመ፡ አመ፡ ትበልዑ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ይትከሠቱ፡ አዕይንቲክሙ፡ ወትከውኑ፡ ከመ፡ አማልክት፡ ወታአምሩ፡ ሠናየ፡ ወእኩየ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēlā ʾarwē mədr la-bəʾəsit ʾi-mawitkka təmawwətu ʾəsma yaʾammər ʾəgziʾ kama ʾama təbalʿu ʾəmənnehu yətkaśśatu ʾaʿəyəntikəmu wa-təkawwənu kama ʾamāləkt wa-taʾammərru śannāya wa-ʾəkuya
verses.notes: **The serpent's deception.** Direct citation of Gen 3:4-5: 'you shall not surely die... you will be LIKE GODS (ʾamāləkt = Ge'ez for elohim) knowing good and evil.' **CROSS-CORPUS — note the Ge'ez retains the PLURAL ʾamāləkt 'gods' here, matching the Hebrew plural elohim (k-elohim) in Gen 3:5 (and contrasting with the Greek θεός singular).** The 'like elohim/gods' theme is foundational to the WoH project's Elohim-as-civilization reading.

verses.text_geez: ወርእየት፡ ብእሲት፡ ከመ፡ ሠናይ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዕፅ፡ ለበሊዕ፡ ወሥሙር፡ ለአዕይንት፡ ለርእይ፡ ወአፍቀረቶ፡ ለፍሬሁ፡ ለበሊዕ፡ ወነሥአት፡ እምኔሁ፡ ወበልዐት፡
verses.translit: wa-rəʾəyat bəʾəsit kama śannāy wəʾtu ʿəḍ la-balʿiʿ wa-śmur la-ʾaʿəyənt la-rəʾəy wa-ʾafqaratto la-fərehu la-balʿiʿ wa-naśʾat ʾəmənnehu wa-balʿat
verses.notes: **Eve eats.** Direct citation of Gen 3:6.

verses.text_geez: ወከደነት፡ ቅድመ፡ ሐፍረታ፡ ቈጽለ፡ በለስ፡ ወወሀበት፡ ለአዳም፡ ወበልዐ፡ ወተከሠተት፡ ዐይኑ፡ ወርእየ፡ ከመ፡ ዕሩቅ፡ ውእቱ፡
verses.translit: wa-kaddanat qədma ḥafratā quwāṣla balas wa-wahabat la-ʾAdām wa-balʿa wa-takaśśatat ʿaynu wa-rəʾəya kama ʿəruq wəʾtu
verses.notes: **Eve covers her nakedness with fig-leaves and gives to Adam.** Note: Jubilees has EVE COVER HERSELF FIRST (before giving to Adam) — a sequential clarification not present in Gen 3:6-7. cf. Gen 3:7 (eyes opened, fig leaves).

verses.text_geez: ወነሥአ፡ ቈጽለ፡ ወሰፈየ፡ ሎቱ፡ ቅንዐተ፡ ቈጽል፡ በለስ፡ ወከደነ፡ ሐፍረቶ፡
verses.translit: wa-naśʾa quwāṣla wa-safaya lottu qənʿata quwāṣl balas wa-kaddana ḥafrato
verses.notes: **Adam covers his nakedness.** Sequential clarification of Gen 3:7.

verses.text_geez: ወረገሞ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላክ፡ ለአርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ወተምዕዐ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ለዓለም፡
verses.translit: wa-ragagamo ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāk la-ʾarwē mədr wa-tamʿəʿa lāʿlēhu la-ʿālam
verses.notes: **Curse of the serpent.** Compresses Gen 3:14-15.

verses.text_geez: ወተምዕዐ፡ ላዕለ፡ ብእሲት፡ እስመ፡ ሰምዐት፡ ቃለ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ወበልዐት፡ ወይቤላ፡ አብዝኆ፡ አብዝህ፡ ቍሕተ፡ ወምድረተ፡ ወበቍሕት፡ ትወልዲ፡ ውሉደ፡ ወኀበ፡ ምትኪ፡ ይኩን፡ ምሕያቅኪ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ይኲንነኪ፡
verses.translit: wa-tamʿəʿa lāʿla bəʾəsit ʾəsma samʿat qāla ʾarwē mədr wa-balʿat wa-yəbēlā ʾabəzəḫo ʾabzəh quḥta wa-mədrata wa-ba-quḥt təwallədi wəluda wa-ḫaba mətki yəkun məḥyāqki wa-wəʾtu yəkwannənaki
verses.notes: **Curse of the woman.** Citation/rewrite of Gen 3:16: 'I will greatly multiply your pain and your conception; in pain you shall bring forth children; your desire shall be for your husband, and he shall rule over you.'

verses.text_geez: ወለአዳም፡ ይቤሎ፡ እስመ፡ ሰማዕከ፡ ቃለ፡ ብእሲትከ፡ ወበልዐከ፡ እምነ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዕፅ፡ ዘአዘዝኩከ፡ ኢትብላዕ፡ እምኔሁ፡ ርግምት፡ ምድር፡ በእንቲአከ፡ ሥርወ፡ ወዐጾቅተ፡ ታበቍል፡ ለከ፡ ወትብላዕ፡ እክሎ፡ ለገዳም፡ በሐፃጼ፡ ገጽከ፡ ትበልዕ፡ እክለከ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ትገብእ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ እንተ፡ እምኔሃ፡ ተወሰድከ፡ እስመ፡ ምድር፡ አንተ፡ ወውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ትገብእ፡
verses.translit: wa-la-ʾAdām yəbēlo ʾəsma samāʿka qāla bəʾəsitka wa-balʿaka ʾəm-nə wəʾtu ʿəḍ zaʾazazku-ka ʾi-təbəlāʿ ʾəmənnehu rəgəmət mədr ba-ʾəntiʾaka śərwa wa-ʿaḍoqəta tābaqwəl laka wa-təbəlāʿ ʾəklo la-gadām ba-ḥaḍāḍē gaṣṣəka təbəlāʿ ʾəklaka ʾəska ʾama təgabbəʾ wəsta mədr ʾənta ʾəmənnehā tawasadkka ʾəsma mədr ʾanta wa-wəsta mədr təgabbəʾ
verses.notes: **Curse of Adam.** Citation/rewrite of Gen 3:17-19: thorns, sweat-labor, dust-return.

verses.text_geez: ወገብረ፡ ሎሙ፡ አልባሰ፡ ማእሰ፡ ወአልበሶሙ፡ ወፈነዎሙ፡ እምነ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡
verses.translit: wa-gabra lomu ʾalbāsa māʾsa wa-ʾalbasomu wa-fanawomu ʾəm-nə ganata ʾEdom
verses.notes: **Skin-garments + expulsion.** Citation of Gen 3:21, 23-24.

verses.text_geez: ወወልሐ፡ አዳም፡ በዕለት፡ እንተ፡ ወፅአ፡ እምነ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ዕጣነ፡ ዘሠናይ፡ መዓዛ፡ መልአን፡ ወቅለድፍሬና፡ ወቀርፈ፡ ፊቅማ፡ በነግህ፡ ምስለ፡ ወፅአቱ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ በዕለት፡ እንተ፡ ከደነ፡ ሐፍረቶ፡
verses.translit: wa-walḥa ʾAdām ba-ʿəlat ʾənta waḍʾa ʾəm-nə ganata ʾEdom ʿəṭāna zaśannāya maʿāzā malʾan wa-qələdəfrenā wa-qarfa fiqmā ba-nagə̄h məsla waḍʾatu la-ḍaḥay ba-ʿəlat ʾənta kaddana ḥafrato
verses.notes: **ADAM AS THE FIRST PRIEST — offers incense (frankincense, galbanum, sweet spices, frankincense, myrrh-resin) at sunrise on the day of his expulsion.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — ADAM-AS-PROTO-PRIEST**: this is one of the most distinctive Jubilees-features: the FALL is COUPLED to the institution of incense-offering — Adam leaves the temple-Eden and immediately performs the first temple-style cultic act. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Vita Adae et Evae 29-30 (similar Adam-cult); cf. Apoc. Mos. 29; cf. Heb 7-8 (priestly-typology); cf. Sirach 49:16 (Adam glorified above every living). **The incense-list parallels the holy-incense recipe of Exod 30:34** (stacte, onycha, galbanum, frankincense) — Adam's offering is the proto-temple-incense.

verses.text_geez: ወእምይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ተአተወ፡ አፉሆሙ፡ ለኵሉ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእንስሳ፡ ወአዕዋፍ፡ ወዘይትሐወስ፡ ወዘይትዐለው፡ እምነ፡ ተናግሮ፡ እስመ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ በበ፡ ቃሎሙ፡ ይትናገሩ፡ አሐደ፡ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡ በቃል፡ አሐዱ፡ ወልሳን፡ አሐዱ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəm-yəʾəti ʿəlat taʾatawa ʾafuhomu la-kwəlu ʾarāwit wa-ʾənəssā wa-ʾaʿwāf wa-zayətḥawwas wa-zayətʿalaw ʾəm-nə tanāgəro ʾəsma kwəlomu baba qālomu yətnāgaru ʾaḥada məsla kāləʾu ba-qāl ʾaḥadu wa-ləssān ʾaḥadu
verses.notes: **ANIMAL-LANGUAGE LOST AT THE FALL.** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE: before the fall, ALL ANIMALS SPOKE ONE LANGUAGE WITH HUMANS; after the fall, animal-speech is silenced.** This is the etiological frame for Eve's pre-fall conversation with the serpent (no surprise that she understood the serpent — all animals talked). **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Vita Adae et Evae 37 (animals spoke before fall); cf. Numbers 22:28-30 (Balaam's ass speaks — a residual remnant of the pre-fall animal-speech tradition). One language, one speech — a paradisiacal unity broken by the fall (and broken again at Babel for humans, cf. Jub 10:25).

verses.text_geez: ወአውፅአ፡ እምነ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ኵሎ፡ ሥጋ፡ ዘሀሎ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ወተዘርዉ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ኵሉ፡ በበ፡ ዘመዱ፡ ወበበ፡ ምስሎሙ፡ በምድር፡ ዘተአዘዘ፡ ሎቱ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾawḍəʾa ʾəm-nə ganata ʾEdom kwəlo śəgā zahallo wəsta ganata ʾEdom wa-tazarwə kwəlu śəgā kwəlu baba zamadu wa-baba məslomu ba-mədr za-taʾazaza lottu
verses.notes: **Animals also expelled from Eden, dispersed by kind.** Continues the Eden-as-cosmic-center motif: the fall affects all flesh, not just humans.

verses.text_geez: ወለአዳም፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ወሀቦ፡ ይከድን፡ ሐፍረቶ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእንስሳ፡
verses.translit: wa-la-ʾAdām bāḥtitu wahabō yəkaddən ḥafrato lāʿla kwəlu ʾarāwit wa-ʾənəssā
verses.notes: **To Adam alone (of all flesh) was given the covering of nakedness — animals were not given coverings.** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — NAKEDNESS-COVERING AS HUMAN-MARK.** Foundational Qumran-purity-halakhah: cf. CD 11:22 + 4QMMT B 67-74 (Qumran nakedness rules). The Jubilees etiology grounds the prohibition of nakedness in creation-order: humans are distinguished from animals by the requirement to cover.

verses.text_geez: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ዘይከድኑ፡ ሐፍረቶሙ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ የአምሩ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ወአላበስዎሙ፡ ከመ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ወአላበሰ፡ ሐፍረቶሙ፡
verses.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu taʾazaza lāʿla ṣəlāt zayəkadnu ḥafratomu kwəlomu ʾəlla yaʾammərru fətḥa wa-ʾallabasəwomu kama ʾaḥzāb wa-ʾallabasa ḥafratomu
verses.notes: **'Therefore it was commanded ON THE HEAVENLY TABLETS' that all who know-the-law should cover their nakedness, not be naked like the nations.** **HEAVENLY-TABLETS REFERENCE — second in this chapter.** The polemic against Gentile nakedness (Hellenistic gymnasion-culture) is sharp: Jewish identity = covered body. Reflects 2nd c. BCE Maccabean-era polemic context (cf. 1 Macc 1:14-15 — the Hellenizing high priests building a Greek gymnasium). **Bidirectional with v2.67.0 heavenly-tablets glossary entry.**

verses.text_geez: ወእምነ፡ ርእሰ፡ ካልእ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ሐነጹ፡ ሎሙ፡ ቤተ፡ በምድር፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ ተፈጥረ፡ አዳም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəm-nə rəʾəsa kāləʾ ʾiyobēləwu ḥanaḍṣu lomu bēta ba-mədr zawəstatēhā tafaṭra ʾAdām
verses.notes: **At the beginning of the 2nd jubilee they built a house in the land where Adam was created.** **CRITICAL: Adam is created OUTSIDE Eden (in 'the land of Eldad' — equivalent to elsewhere named locations).** **Jubilees-distinctive: Adam-created-outside-Eden then brought-in is the basis for the 40-day purity period of v 9 above.** Jubilees and rabbinic tradition diverge here from Genesis 2 (which reads as Adam created in Eden).

verses.text_geez: ወአዳም፡ የአምር፡ ለብእሲቱ፡ ኤዋ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ቃየል፡ ወአቤል፡ ወለክልኤሆሙ፡ አንስት፡ አሐቲ፡ ኣዋን፡ ወአሐቲ፡ አዙራ፡ ወወሀብናሁ፡ ለቃየል፡ ኣዋን፡ እኅቶ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወሀብናሁ፡ ለሴት፡ አዙራ፡ እኅቶ፡ ብእሲተ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾAdām yaʾammər la-bəʾəsitu ʾEwa wa-waladat lottu Qāyāl wa-ʾAbēl wa-la-kələʾēhomu ʾanəst ʾaḥati ʾAwān wa-ʾaḥati ʾAzurā wa-wahabnāhu la-Qāyāl ʾAwān ʾəḫto bəʾəsita wa-wahabnāhu la-Set ʾAzurā ʾəḫto bəʾəsita
verses.notes: **THE SISTERS-WIVES OF CAIN AND SETH NAMED: AWAN (wife of Cain) and AZURA (wife of Seth).** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — JUBILEES NAMES THE PRE-FLOOD WIVES.** This solves the perennial Cain-wife problem (Gen 4:17 — where does Cain's wife come from?). Jubilees: Cain married his sister Awan. **CROSS-CORPUS**: the sister-wife tradition is also in Genesis Apocryphon (1Q20), Pseudo-Philo Biblical Antiquities, and various rabbinic + Christian traditions. **AWAN** appears here for the first time; **AZURA** likewise. **Cain and Abel are born in this verse but Abel's death is in the next chapter (Jub 4:1-7).**

verses.text_geez: ወቃየል፡ ቀተሎ፡ ለአቤል፡ እስመ፡ ይትገበር፡ መሥዋዕቱ፡ ወመሥዋዕተ፡ አቤልሰ፡ ኢተገብረ፡
verses.translit: wa-Qāyāl qatalo la-ʾAbēl ʾəsma yətgabbar maśwāʿtu wa-maśwāʿta ʾAbēlsa ʾi-tagabra
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 3:34; VanderKam 1989) — note: VanderKam moves this material to Jub 4:2
verses.notes: **Cain kills Abel because his sacrifice was accepted and Cain's was not.** The verse-numbering between Charles and VanderKam differs at this transition — VanderKam treats the Cain-Abel material as opening Jub 4, Charles ends Jub 3 here. Following VanderKam structure, this verse is the final summary-link. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 4:1-8; cf. Heb 11:4 (Abel's sacrifice 'more excellent'); cf. 1 John 3:12 (Cain 'of the evil one'); cf. Matt 23:35 (Abel's blood).

verses.text_geez: ወእምድኅረዝ፡ መውት፡ ኮኖ፡ ለአዳም፡ ጊዜ፡ ፈጸመ፡ ምልአ፡ ዓመቱ፡ ወእንሰ፡ ዘመነ፡ መውት፡ ይከውን፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫrazə mawt kono la-ʾAdām gizē faṣṣama mələʾa ʿāmatu wa-ʾənsa zamana mawt yəkawwən
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 3:35; VanderKam 1989) — note: precise verse-division differs; the chapter-end transition material is sometimes attributed to ch 4
verses.notes: **Transitional concluding line — links to ch 4 patriarchal-death sequence.** Adam's death will be narrated in 4:29-30.
